$schema: experiment record contract v1 (generic simulation record)
notes: resource must carry a describe() dict: {kind, value, params}
t_final is MODEL time and steps is the iteration count; both are recorded because one cannot be derived from the other when dt or the solver changes
a run whose status is failed must carry at least one anomaly string, so a silent failure cannot enter the index
shape fields (Rg, centroid, cx, cy) may be null iff there is no structure to measure (vmax==0 or active_area_cells==0); Mv and vmax must always be present
components is the shape decomposition of the structure, so it follows the shape-field nullability rule
